# Nerd Fonts Symbols Only

OShell bundles the unmodified `SymbolsNerdFontMono-Regular.ttf` from Nerd Fonts **v3.4.0** as an app-private fallback for missing terminal prompt icons.

- Source: https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/tag/v3.4.0
- Archive: https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/download/v3.4.0/NerdFontsSymbolsOnly.zip
- Font SHA-256: `f0f624d9b474bea1662cf7e862d44aebe1ae1f6c7f9cb7a0ca5d0e5ac9561c60`
- Nerd Fonts project license: MIT, Copyright (c) 2014 Ryan L McIntyre; see `LICENSE`.
- Upstream icon license audit: https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/blob/v3.4.0/license-audit.md

The font is not modified, installed globally or used as the primary text font. The application fits missing private-use symbols to the selected terminal font's cell width. Unicode text keeps its normal system fallback.

## Included icon sets

The aggregate font contains third-party icons with their own notices. Copies of the upstream notices are in `licenses/`; those licenses are not replaced by OShell's GPL license.

| Icon set / upstream | License / notice |
| --- | --- |

| [Devicons](https://github.com/devicons/devicon) | MIT |
| [Hack extra glyphs](https://github.com/source-foundry/Hack) | MIT / included upstream notices |
| [Font Awesome](https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome) | CC BY 4.0 / OFL font notice |
| [Font Awesome Extension](https://github.com/AndreLZGava/font-awesome-extension) | MIT, per Nerd Fonts license audit |
| [Font Logos](https://github.com/lukas-w/font-logos) | Upstream Nerd Fonts audit lists this icon set as unlicensed; logos belong to their respective owners |
| [Material Design Icons](https://github.com/Templarian/MaterialDesign-Font) | Apache 2.0 |
| [Octicons](https://github.com/primer/octicons) | MIT |
| [Seti and original](https://github.com/jesseweed/seti-ui) | MIT; adapted by Nerd Fonts |
| [Pomicons](https://github.com/gabrielelana/pomicons) | OFL 1.1 |
| [Powerline Extra](https://github.com/ryanoasis/powerline-extra-symbols) | MIT |
